reviews.title: Died with very light usage after 1 1/2 years...
reviews.comment: Very disappointed in this card and ASRock! Keep in mind, this card have VERY light usage. This is the first AMD card I have ever owned and will be my last thanks to ASrock. Bought the card back in March of 2021, woke up one morning and my PC refused to boot to windows. After 3 days of troubleshooting came to find out it was the GPU (even though the GPU's fans and the outputs work just fine, when ANY version of the AMD drivers are installed the card dies). Contacted ASrock, said it out of warranty by 5 months. They didn't care so I dont care that they lose mine and several other gamers business now. Well done ASrock!
reviews.author: Gstel
